title: storage chest
text: storage chest. I purchased this for a tiny room.  It functions as a seating area (like to pull up your socks or put on your shoes) and to store spare bedding  - and it is set at the end of twin size bed.  It fits perfectly there..  It is black.  The legs are wooden (or wooden like). It has 2 hinges that hold the lid open.  It is sturdy. The top is buttoned and cushy. The inside is roomy for it's size and holds the spare sheets easily and has room for a small quilt too. It is a leather like material and is made in China.  It arrived fully assembled and nicely packed with a custom made cover, lightweight cloth cover - that was cinched at the bottom.  I have included some pics... if they make it past the Amazon photo trolls - I do really try to provide as many as possible of pics I would like to see if I were looking myself.  I like this chest and think it will last as long as I would like it to - time will tell of course. I think it looks better than the price paid in my personal opinion.  I never hesitate to update my review should new info seem useful.
